certification.name: Certificate of the Business Continuity Institute
certification.description: Business continuity certificate based on the BCI Good Practice Guidelines 7.0 and its six professional practices. Online proctored closed-book exam of 90 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes with a pass mark of 63.
certification.currency_note: Exam is sold with the CBCI course or a BCI Shop bundle; the certification pages show no price
